description: Get the current date and time. Call this before writing any date, timestamp, year, changelog entry, migration filename or copyright line -- your training data predates today. The text content is the requested `format` only; read `structuredContent` for the same instant stated as UTC (`iso`, `utc`), host-local with offset (`local`, `offset`, `timezone`) and epoch milliseconds, so there is never any doubt which clock a value came from.

format.description: "iso" (default unless configured otherwise) returns UTC, e.g. 2026-08-20T12:31:02.625Z. Anything else is a token pattern rendered in the host's LOCAL time and must contain at least one token; free text is rejected. Tokens: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, SSS, Z, ZZ. Named patterns: filename, logdate, simple. Examples: "YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss", "YYYY-MM-DD-HHmmss", "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ" (local time with its real offset).

provider.description: "local" (default) reads the system clock. "remote" queries a network time service and fails rather than silently substituting the local clock.

timezone.description: Zone for `local`, `offset`, `timezone` and any token format. IANA name such as "UTC", "Europe/Berlin", "America/New_York" or "Asia/Kolkata". Defaults to the host machine's zone. Does not affect `iso`/`utc`, which are always UTC.

name: get_current_datetime

formatted.description: The requested `format`, rendered. Same value as the text content.

iso.description: The instant as ISO 8601 UTC. Use this for machine timestamps.

local.description: Host-local clock reading as ISO 8601 with its real offset, e.g. 2026-08-20T14:31:02.625+02:00.

provider.description: Which provider actually answered. Differs from the request only on fallback.

timezone.description: IANA zone that `local` and `offset` are stated in, e.g. "Europe/Berlin".

utc.description: UTC clock reading. Identical to `iso` in this version.

title: Get current date and time
